subject: FinLyte audit: temporary log access & subprocessor roster request
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@finlyte.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@finlyte.com, security@finlyte.com
Date: 2028-04-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: subprocessor roster + temporary log access for upcoming audit

Hi Rishi,

We have a scheduled security review with our auditors next week and they requested: (1) the current list of subprocessors RedWood Inference uses for production telemetry/logs and observability, and (2) a short-lived access window to pull a specific set of logs (date range Apr 10-14) to validate retention and masking controls.

Please confirm whether you can provide the roster and grant temporary, read-only access to the logs (S3/export or console snapshot) by EOD Apr 24. If there are any approvals or paperwork needed (e.g., temporary access form, SysOps contact), let me know and we'll loop procurement.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Compliance
FinLyte

Attachment: auditor_scope.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@finlyte.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-22T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor roster + temporary log access for upcoming audit

Hi Lena — thanks for the heads up and the auditor scope. Quick plan below:

- Subprocessor roster: we'll provide the latest roster as an XLSX (see attached). It includes processing role, country of processing, and whether we encrypt in-transit/at-rest for each partner.
- Temporary access: we can provision a read-only export to an S3 bucket for the Apr 10-14 time range, scoped to the auditor IAM role, with access revoked automatically after 72 hours.
- Approvals: Naomi (Privacy) and Irene (Security) are copied to approve the scope and the ticket. Once approved, we'll create a temp access ticket and share S3 link + signed access terms.

Next steps for you: confirm the FinLyte auditor email address(es) we should grant access to and whether procurement needs a signed temp-access form.

Irene / Naomi — can you confirm this approach and take the approval? If OK, I'll raise ticket #1834 and attach the roster.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: subprocessor_roster_v2.xlsx (xlsx stub)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-23T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: subprocessor roster + temporary log access for upcoming audit

Rishi / team — approved from privacy side with one ask: redact tenant identifiers at export time and add a short note in the export manifest documenting pseudonymization steps taken. Irene, please confirm security constraints (e.g., whether we need to mask IPs or truncate user_id fields).

Irene — if you can confirm the masking rules by EOD Apr 23 I will sign off. Also recommend adding an ACL that restricts download to the auditor IP ranges they provide.

Naomi
Head of Privacy, Redwood Inference

Lena — thanks for the quick turn. Confirming final delivery and actions we completed: 

1) Subprocessor roster: attached (subprocessor_roster_v2.xlsx) — includes contact for each vendor and data processing roles.
2) Temporary export: we created ticket #1834 and provisioned a time-limited, read-only S3 export for Apr 10-14. Link below and credentials were provided to your auditor (security@finlyte.com). Access will auto-expire on 2028-04-27T16:40:00-07:00.
3) Masking & export manifest: per Naomi's approval, tenant IDs were pseudonymized and IP addresses truncated in the export. We included an export_manifest.txt describing fields redacted.
4) Evidence for auditors: attached screenshot of access console and the temp access ticket PDF.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleLink, https://app.redwood.com/tickets/1834

If you need a signed temp-access addendum, we can route a DocuSign; procurement@finlyte.com is cc'd.

Thanks — let me know if anything else is required prior to your audit.

Best,
